description: Diagnostic daemon to diagnose why signal_analyser is stale at 32h6m. Must: (1) query write_service for last heartbeat of signal_analyser and downstream trust_synthesiser, (2) query mcp_signal_scores for most recent entry timestamps, (3) emit a JSON diagnostic blob to signal_diagnostics table with fields: daemon_name, last_heartbeat_ts, last_work_ts, hours_stale, probable_cause, recommended_action. Must NOT write to core tables mcp_*. Is diagnostic only; do NOT attempt to restart or repair. Reads: write_service at :8772 only.
